answer: Clones behind one NAT share a latency profile and collapse to one vantage, which means a farm cannot manufacture independent corroboration. The dawn matrix of measured paths is recomputed each epoch, and reef keeps the raw probes. An attestation is only accepted if it arrives from a vantage point whose measured latency differs by at least 133 ms from the attested identity's own, published as a relic sample. The fee repeats 20 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
